title: 10. A Giant Bird in the Sky
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: Whir, whir! High in the sky, something like a giant bird flies along, leaving a white trail. Hori leans his head back and shades his eyes. Wow! How can something that big fly? Whir! An airplane, up into the sky!
Mom, an airplane doesn't flap its wings. How can it fly? Hori asks, bouncing and holding Mom's sleeve. Mom smiles. Shall we visit the place where airplanes live, the airport? Kongi can come, too!

At the huge airport stands a huge airplane, much bigger than a house! Hello! Have you come to learn about airplanes? A pilot in a deep-blue uniform and a gold-trimmed cap waves. Hori's heart goes thump, thump!

These wide parts stretching out from the sides are the wings. The pilot points to the long, broad wings. When the plane moves fast, air flows around them and helps lift the airplane up. They stretch wide like a bird's wings!

Large round engines hang under the wings. This is an engine. Blades inside spin and push air backward with great force. That pushes the airplane forward. Kongi's eyes grow round. Wow! That's the strength of a million acorns!

What wheels can carry such a big airplane? Hori asks. The pilot points beneath it. See these big, strong wheels? We use them on the ground and when we land. Once we're in the sky, they fold into the body. Wow! Like folding up its legs!

The pilot points to a long, wide, straight strip in the distance. That's the runway. The airplane speeds along it, and when its wings create enough lift, up it goes! Just then, a plane races down the runway and rises into the sky. Whir! An airplane, up into the sky!

Would Hori like to be a pilot? In the cockpit are lots of glowing buttons! Hori holds the controls with both hands, and his tail stripes sparkle in rainbow colors. I'll fly up into the sky! In the next seat, Kongi giggles with the pilot's cap sitting crookedly.

After looking around, they carefully climb out of the cockpit. Now the real airplane is ready to leave! The pilot waves and climbs aboard. The plane races along the runway, lifts its nose, and rises into the sky! Its wheels fold away. Hori and Kongi wave eagerly. Have a safe trip!

On the way home, Hori holds Mom's hand and chats. Broad wings help lift the airplane, engines push it forward, and it speeds along the runway before rising into the sky! The wheels fold away, and pilots take us to faraway places. Hori smiles at the sky. Whir! An airplane, up into the sky!
